ground_truth.what_company_does: Direct-to-consumer car finance and mobility platform that lets consumers arrange car finance upfront through a digital app experience.
ground_truth.problem: Consumers distrust dealership finance, face opaque terms, and encounter outdated finance workflows.
ground_truth.solution: AI-powered, digital-first car finance experience with fast approval, transparent financing, vehicle history checks, instant payment, and servicing in-app.
ground_truth.why_now: Car-buying behavior is shifting online and finance-first, trust in incumbents is low, and AI / fintech infrastructure enables better user experience.
ground_truth.business_model: Consumer fintech / mobility platform / lender-enabled finance platform
ground_truth.revenue_model: Revenue from car finance and related lending economics, with future cross-sell into insurance, marketplace, and ownership-wallet products.
ground_truth.go_to_market: Direct, comparison sites, partners, and AI-powered acquisition / pricing channels.
ground_truth.target_customer: Used-car buyers seeking transparent direct-to-consumer financing.
ground_truth.traction_summary: $0 to roughly $28M-$29M ARR in 3 years, about 18,000 active customers, about $350M cars financed, 11-month CAC payback, and strong NPS.
ground_truth.market_positioning: Direct-to-consumer alternative to dealership-led car financing, with strong UX, AI, and capital-light scaling model.
ground_truth.competitive_differentiation: Fast approval, AI decisioning, proprietary technology stack, strong NPS, efficient unit economics, and capital-light forward-flow model.
ground_truth.risks: Credit performance, CAC durability, funding and cost-of-capital risk, execution on adjacent expansion, and regulatory / lending market dynamics.

investor_relevance_notes: This is a direct-to-consumer car-finance and mobility platform, not a generic SaaS business.
A strong understanding should separate current traction from forward-looking 2030 revenue projections.
Important diligence areas include credit performance, funding costs, CAC durability, repeat usage, and regulatory exposure.
The system should recognize the capital-light forward-flow model and not confuse it with a balance-sheet-heavy lender only.
Expansion into insurance, marketplace, and ownership wallet should be treated as roadmap or adjacency, not current core revenue.
